vb_textbox.text: My advice would be to ensure that in the practice round, you take advantage of familarising yourself with the process. If you can, try to get into a rythem if possible as it helps you to concetrate and it makes the game progress smoother. Initially I accepted the first 5 minute break but did not accept the others. Ift may help to ensure that at least some breaks are taken as otherwise your hands may struggle, or you run the risk of concetration lasping.
